description: The MCP server's resources, read whole with resources/read. The JSON one carries the schema of its contents.

resources.name: builds
resources.title: Game builds Everloot knows
resources.description: The build the game-file facts come from, and every build Blizzard's version service has listed, with when Everloot first saw it. JSON of the shape in schema/mcp/resources.json.

definitions.description: The WoWDBDefs commit the column names came from.

gameFiles.description: The build the game-file facts (entity_relations, item_categories) were read from.

product.description: Blizzard's product id, such as wow_classic_beta.

firstSeen.description: When Everloot first saw the build, not Blizzard's release time.

registry.description: Every build the version service has listed, newest first.

credit.description: Game-file facts are Blizzard's, not under Everloot's licence.

resources.name: methodology
resources.title: How Everloot counts
resources.description: How player uploads become facts: three installs must agree, unrecorded is never zero, game files and play are kept apart, and what is never published. Read it before stating a number as certain.

resources.name: data-policy
resources.title: Everloot data policy
resources.description: Where the data comes from, what is refused, the licence and credit line, and the limits on bulk copying, in short, with the link to the full policy.
